predecessors.name: French Fifth Republic
predecessors.text: Niger, an autonomous republic within the French Community from 18 December 1958

ledger.x: 2005: the International Court of Justice divides the Niger River islands.

wars.name: First Tuareg Rebellion
wars.outcome: The attack on Tchintabaraden in the Agadez Region is 'seen by some as the start of the first Tuareg Rebellion (1990-1995)'; 'In April 1995 a peace deal with a Tuareg rebel group was signed.'

wars.name: Second Tuareg Rebellion
wars.outcome: 'The north saw the outbreak of a Second Tuareg Rebellion in 2007'; 'the rebellion had ceased by 2009'.

wars.name: Benin-Niger frontier dispute
wars.outcome: Not a war: a dispute over 24 (or 25) islands in the Niger River, sent to the International Court of Justice in 2001 and decided in 2005 (16 to Niger, nine to Benin).

certainty.note: Colonial frontiers (the Nigerian frontier 'finalised in 1910', the Benin frontier on the Niger and Mékrou rivers confirmed by a French statute of 27 October 1938).
